meta.name: caveman
meta.description: Ultra-compressed communication mode that cuts output tokens while keeping technical accuracy. Levels: lite, full, ultra and the wenyan variants. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把冗长回复压成极简短句,省字又不丢技术要点。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果嫌 AI 回话啰嗦,想用更少字数抓到关键信息。
copy.tagline_en: Compress long replies into terse lines that keep the technical points.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if replies feel too wordy and you want the key points in fewer words.

howto.what: Claude 的回复变成极简压缩风格:技术内容原样保留,去掉客套、填充词和冠词,允许碎片句。默认 full 档,可切 lite、ultra 及文言变体,整场会话持续生效直到你叫停。
howto.when: 当你输入 /caveman,或说出 “caveman mode”、“be brief” 等说法时触发,并接管本会话后续所有回复。

say.note: 切到 ultra 档,压缩最狠
切到 lite 档,保留完整句子

howto.what_en: Claude answers in an ultra-compressed style: technical substance stays, filler, pleasantries and articles go, fragments allowed. Default level full; switch lite/ultra/wenyan variants. Lasts the whole session until you stop it.
howto.when_en: Triggers on /caveman, or when you say "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens"; it then governs every reply in the session.
